channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jeff Van Gundy | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jeff Van Gundy from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: James Harden on Jeff Van Gundy
item.description:
James Harden on coach Jeff Van Gundy:

“He's a psycho in a good way... He'll write me notes and leave them in my locker.”

James Harden on Jeff Van Gundy, Jan 28, 2026. Source: reddit.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Jeff Van Gundy
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau on Celtics hiring Jeff Van Gundy:

“He's a great asset to have for the coaching staff and the front office.”

Tom Thibodeau on Jeff Van Gundy, Oct 17, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Jeff Van Gundy
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Jeff Van Gundy:

“Anytime you can add high-character, professional people, I think it’s a no-brainer. Fortunate enough that he’s here, not just for the coaching staff, but everybody.”

Joe Mazzulla on Jeff Van Gundy, Oct 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: JJ Redick on Mark Jackson, Jeff Van Gundy, Mike Breen
item.description:
“It’s going to be a little weird, for sure. I felt like Mark (Jackson) and Jeff (Van Gundy) and Mike (Breen) is just such an iconic team. And they’ve been on the call for so many historic moments, at least historic moments in my generation. So It’s gonna be weird,”

JJ Redick on Mark Jackson, Jeff Van Gundy, Mike Breen, Aug 8, 2023. Source: Front Office Sports.

item.title: Flip Saunders on Jeff Van Gundy
item.description:
And Saunders said he tried, starting out with his former ESPN colleague Jeff Van Gundy.

“The first guy that I went to and tried to get was Jeff Van Gundy. He was the first guy,”

Flip Saunders on Jeff Van Gundy, Jun 6, 2014. Source: Minneapolis Star-Tribune.

item.title: David Wesley on Jeff Van Gundy
item.description:
“He is great at controlling egos and tempers, making sure everything is right and that you can function as a team. That is what he excelled at a lot. Jeff Van Gundy was more of a tactical, instinct guy. He would just say, ‘This is how it is,’ he would give you the hard truth, take it or leave it. I think you can learn a lot from personalities like that.”

David Wesley on Jeff Van Gundy, Jun 11, 2011. Source: Sporting News.

item.title: Scottie Pippen on Jeff Van Gundy
item.description:
“But if Jeff Van Gundy wants to take a bet, I would bet him that they won't break it.”

Scottie Pippen on Jeff Van Gundy, Aug 13, 2010. Source: ESPN.com.
